description:
Cast Chamber Sentry by paying {0}.
Chamber Sentry enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Liliana, Dreadhorde General.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Chamber Sentry from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Chamber Sentry from your library.
Repeat.
